# Requirements

Each student will be required to submit ONE term paper (and presentation slides) by March 26, 2026 and make a related oral presentation in the class on April 2, 2026. Each student will be given 15 minutes for the presentation, followed by about 2 minutes of questions.  Our current enrollment is 7 (until Jan 5), if the class size further expands, I will consider prerecording the presentation as a second choice.

Term paper length requirements 2,500~3,500 words

Format  
Please follow the style of SME Transactions:  

http://transactions.smenet.org/docs/Publications/Transactions/How_to_Submit_to_Transactions.pdf (@HowSubmitTransactions)

Grading Criteria

Format (10%)
Submissions following the proposed schedule (20%)
Content completeness and Originality (20%)
Discussions and Contributions (20%)
Paper organization (10%)
Unity, coherence, and logic (20%)
